description: When the Slack bot returned channel_not_found for #content, fell back to posting to #jarvis instead of invoking the master-slack skill as specified in the workflow. The skill exists precisely to handle routing — it should have been invoked and its output + any failures surfaced to David for a decision, not silently rerouted to a different channel.
correction: When posting to Slack is required by a workflow step, always invoke the master-slack skill. If the channel is unreachable, surface the failure and stop — do not reroute to a different channel without explicit instruction. Channel selection is David's decision, not a fallback the agent makes unilaterally.
systemic_fix: Before any Slack send in a workflow context, read the workflow file to confirm the target channel and invoke master-slack skill. If the send fails, report the failure with the channel ID and error — never substitute a different channel.
